value.rationale: Crown graphs are a canonical perfect-matching deletion from complete bipartite graphs. The theorem identifies exactly how those missing matched adjacencies alter defender swaps, gives a complete bivariate configuration enumerator, and classifies all minimum configurations for the stable range n >= 5. This is a natural structural invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
